references.text: Here the people's craving for meat is described, which led to the place being called Kibroth-hattaavah (graves of craving)
Kibroth-hattaavah is mentioned as one of the camp sites during Israel's journey in the wilderness
Moses reminds the people that they provoked the Lord's anger at Taberah, Massah, and Kibroth-hattaavah
The psalm describes how God's wrath came upon the people while they still had food in their mouths, because of their craving
Describes how the people gave in to craving in the wilderness and tested God
Paul warns against craving evil things as the fathers did in the wilderness
